name: River Development Agent Controlled Operation Execution Boundary Foundation
architecture: GENERATION III CONTROLLED OPERATION EXECUTION BOUNDARY FOUNDATION
invariants: DEV-275 consumes only the exact DEV-274 operation-execution-authorization result contract.
DEV-275 denies execution when the predecessor is malformed, untrusted, unready, unauthorized, blocked, inconsistent, or missing required execution-chain evidence.
DEV-275 permits only one exact previously authorized operation within the exact approved execution scope.
DEV-275 does not create new execution authorization.
DEV-275 does not grant arbitrary shell or process execution authority.
DEV-275 does not grant network execution authority.
DEV-275 does not grant deployment authority.
DEV-275 does not grant secret-access authority.
DEV-275 does not stage, commit, or push repository changes.
DEV-275 does not delete repository content.
DEV-275 does not permit repository mutation beyond the exact previously authorized operation.
Rejected predecessor payloads release no trusted predecessor payload.
Execution evidence must preserve predecessor provenance, scope, authorization, dispatch, invocation, and operation evidence.
A future explicit execution-receipt boundary is required before downstream lifecycle progression.
